groups.name: tail
groups.reason: tail is driven at runtime by runtime/tail_physics.js (see top-level "tail" block); no baked keys, no spring_bones

groups.name: crest
groups.reason: crest wisps are baked in the clips (small sway), no spring

groups.name: wing_feathers
groups.reason: feather rows are animated in the clips (lagged flap + baked flame ripple: outward-travelling layered waves, flickering amplitude, in every clip); no spring

global.note: no cloth bones on this model; tail uses tail_physics.js (bird preset)

tail.note: bird preset = light feather tail; the clips contain NO tail rotation tracks (tail stays at rest pose so tail_physics owns it): slow elegant trail, no side wag. Overrides allowed (freq, zeta, lift, accelDroop, yawLag, maxYaw ...).
